# Vendored browser assets

- Bootstrap 5.3.3: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap (MIT; see bootstrap/LICENSE)
- Font Awesome Free 6.4.0: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome (see fontawesome/LICENSE.txt)

Copied from the corresponding official npm packages. Upgrade deliberately and retain upstream licenses. These are source static assets; collectstatic copies them into the ignored root static/ directory. Korean/Chinese text uses the reader's system fonts without requiring an external font CDN.
